finding.claim: AddressError.parseMessage inserts raw attacker characters into HTML for bad-character errors, contrary to the documented escaping contract (address-error.ts:8-11).
finding.source: Untrusted string passed to new Address6() (Address6.isValid, Address6.fromURL, any constructor call)
finding.sink: parseMessage HTML fragment built by address.replace(RE_BAD_CHARACTERS, '$1') at src/ipv6.ts:804-809

trace.note: RE_BAD_CHARACTERS = /([^0-9a-f:/%])/gi matches every char outside hex, colon, slash, percent
parse() runs badCharacters match on the address
replacement inserts $1 (the raw bad char) without escapeHtml
doc claims address content is HTML-escaped and safe to insert as-is

finding.guards_checked: Bad-char gate throws before RE_BAD_ADDRESS path (ipv6.ts:803-819, that path is safe). parse4in6 prefix is escaped (ipv6.ts:763). Text-context insertion is inert because each raw char is wrapped as X and '<' is followed by '<'. Exploitable only if a consumer inserts parseMessage into an HTML attribute.

finding.claim: simpleGroup returns its input unescaped when a group contains 'group-v4', exposing raw HTML through the public v6.helpers export.
finding.source: String passed directly to v6.helpers.simpleGroup (publicly exported at src/ip-address.ts:5-7)
finding.sink: Raw return of g at src/v6/helpers.ts:52-54, skipping the escape applied at helpers.ts:56
finding.guards_checked: Library-internal group() (ipv6.ts:1514-1517) cannot reach this branch because valid addresses cannot contain 'g'. Exposure is only through direct helper calls with untrusted strings. Verdict PLAUSIBLE, low.

finding.claim: isLinkLocal() returns false for addresses inside fe80::/10 that have nonzero bits 10-63 (e.g. fe80:1::1), while getType() classifies them as Link-local unicast.
finding.source: Untrusted IPv6 host string, e.g. from Address6.fromURL('http://[fe80:1::1]/')
finding.sink: isLinkLocal() used as a trust-boundary classifier (SSRF allow/deny style filters)

trace.note: requires getBitsBase2(0,64) to equal fe80:0000:0000:0000 exactly, so fe80:0001:... fails
getType uses isHostInSubnet against the fe80::/10 entry and returns Link-local unicast

finding.guards_checked: isPrivate (ipv6.ts:1380-1387) and isLoopback (ipv6.ts:1345-1352) also return false for this address. Practical impact is limited because link-local connects usually need a scope ID and fromURL rejects '%' (constants v6:84). Verdict PLAUSIBLE, low.
